title: Wizball
build: Yeti's one-file crack, WIZBALL    /YETI on the c64.com disk WWW.C64HQ.COM (with Impact's and Remember's cracks beside it); the game starts at $6389

tools.emulator: VICE 3.10 via vice-mcp 3.13.1: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.1, commit fdc435caee (Linux x86_64 GTK3 build from source, run under Xvfb)
tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04 cloud container with four cores and no display

exclude: title sprites $80-$8E; in play the score rows and landscape screen 0, drawn at run time
unused, and screen 0's sprite pointers, written by the play bands
landscape screen 1, drawn at run time
level-digit sprite $A0 and landscape screen 2, drawn at run time
text screen of the title, menus and get-ready screen; sprites and icon pointers in play
bottom band's sprite pointers, written every frame
star glyphs, cleared and plotted at run time
level glyphs, copied in for each level from the blocks at $0B42
include: RAM under the I/O area: sprite blocks $40-$7F, loaded with the game and read by the video chip in bank 3
